description: This Java source file defines the ServerConfig class, which provides configuration properties and methods for managing server network settings such as ports, addresses, and TLS/security features within the Eclipse Hono project.

classes.name: ServerConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for server network properties including ports, addresses, and TLS/security settings. Extends AbstractConfig and provides getters and setters to manage server behavior.

methods.name: getBindAddress
methods.description: Returns the network interface address to which the server's secure port is bound.

methods.name: setBindAddress
methods.description: Sets the network interface address for the server's secure port, requiring a non-null string.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the configured secure port number.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the configured secure port number, or the provided default if not explicitly set.

methods.name: setPort
methods.description: Sets the secure port number, validating that it is within valid port range.

methods.name: isSecurePortEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether the server's secure port with key/certificate is enabled.

methods.name: isNativeTlsRequired
methods.description: Indicates whether the server requires native TLS implementation.

methods.name: setNativeTlsRequired
methods.description: Sets whether the server should require the usage of native TLS.

methods.name: isInsecurePortEnabled
methods.description: Indicates if insecure ports (without TLS) are enabled.

methods.name: setInsecurePortEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables support for insecure ports.

methods.name: getInsecurePortBindAddress
methods.description: Returns the network address for the insecure port.

methods.name: setInsecurePortBindAddress
methods.description: Sets the bind address for the insecure port, requiring non-null input.

methods.name: getInsecurePort
methods.description: Returns the insecure port number or the specified default if not set.

methods.name: setInsecurePort
methods.description: Sets the insecure port number and enables insecure port support.
